title: Transport of evaluation biduality across an invertible dualizing twist
statement:
Let $A$ be a commutative ring, let $g:T\to V$ be a scheme morphism, and use ordinary constant-$A$ modules on small etale sites and their unbounded derived categories [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories]. Use derived tensor and internal Hom [def-kun-derived-tensor, def-pur-derived-internal-hom]. Assume the inverse image $g^*$ is exact and strong symmetric monoidal. Let $\Omega\in D(V_{\mathrm{et}},A)$ and $\Omega'\in D(T_{\mathrm{et}},A)$, and fix an isomorphism $\theta:g^*\Omega\xrightarrow{\sim}\Omega'\otimes_A^L J$, where $J=Q[m]$, $m\in\mathbf Z$, and $Q$ is an etale locally constant rank-one $A_T$-module sheaf with a tensor inverse. Put $D=R\mathcal Hom_A(-,\Omega)$ and $D'=R\mathcal Hom_A(-,\Omega')$. For any object $B$, define $\delta_B:B\to DDB$ as the transpose of evaluation with its tensor factors interchanged by the symmetry; use the same convention for $\delta'$.

Let $K\in D(V_{\mathrm{et}},A)$ and suppose the tensor-adjoint internal-Hom comparisons
$$\beta_{B,\Omega}:g^*R\mathcal Hom_A(B,\Omega)\xrightarrow{\sim}R\mathcal Hom_A(g^*B,g^*\Omega)\qquad(B=K,DK)$$
are isomorphisms and respect evaluation: $\mathrm{ev}\circ(\beta_{B,\Omega}\otimes 1)=g^*\mathrm{ev}_{B,\Omega}$ under the monoidal comparison. Write $P=g^*K$. The canonical invertible-factor Hom isomorphisms give
$$\alpha:g^*DK\xrightarrow{\sim}D'P\otimes_A^L J.$$
Let $\gamma:g^*DDK\xrightarrow{\sim}D'D'P$ be the composite of $\beta_{DK,\Omega}$, the substitution of $\alpha$ in the first Hom variable and $\theta$ in the second, and cancellation
$$R\mathcal Hom_A(D'P\otimes_A^L J,\Omega'\otimes_A^L J)\xrightarrow{\sim}R\mathcal Hom_A(D'P,\Omega').$$
Then $\gamma\circ g^*\delta_K=\delta'_P$. No biduality isomorphism or constructibility is assumed.
